incident_text: De fortes inondations touchent un quartier résidentiel de Nabeul. Plusieurs routes sont bloquées et l'eau continue de monter.

result.scene_summary: A street in a residential area is flooded with brown water, submerging the lower levels of multi-story buildings. No people are visible in the image.

observations.description: Muddy brown water covers the entire street, reaching the base of buildings and submerging ground-level entrances.
Buildings show no obvious structural damage; facades are intact, though lower floors are submerged.
Road signs and street lamps are present but partially submerged. A "Stop" sign is visible on the right.
No people are visible in the image.
A white bag or object is floating in the water on the left.

inconsistencies: Report mentions Nabeul, but image shows European-style architecture and street signs, not consistent with Nabeul (Tunisia).
not_determinable: structural integrity of buildings beyond water level
